# How many days have I spent in each state, and am I near the 183-day line?

> Free multi-state residency day counter. Enter where you spent the year, see days per state against the 183-day and other statutory residency tests, the room you have left, the date you would cross a limit, and remote-work wages split by state. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
